summaries.senate: The Democrats' chances of winning Senate control moved up moderately in the Polymarket odds, and the market continues to favour them. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts gained sharply, while in [[Maine]] the Democrat Troy Jackson moved up moderately in what the market sees as a predicted flip. The Democrat Sherrod Brown also gained ground in Ohio, another predicted flip, and the Republican in South Carolina, Darline Graham Nordone, saw a moderate drop.
summaries.governor: In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground by a sizable margin, and the market treats it as a predicted flip. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Jim Pillen also strengthened noticeably. Over in [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds saw a sizable drop in Polymarket odds.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats favoured to win House control, with their chances edging up slightly. Among individual races, the Republican in [[NC-03 (Greenville & Jacksonville)]], Greg Murphy, strengthened sharply, while the Democrat in [[FL-14 (Plant City)]], Kathy Castor, also gained ground by a sizable amount. In [[NC-09 (Fayetteville & Burlington)]], the Republican Richard Hudson saw a sizable drop in the market's confidence.
